## Feature Description / 功能描述

A clear description of the feature you'd like. / 清楚描述你想要的功能。

## Use Case / 使用场景

Why do you need this? What problem does it solve? / 为什么需要这个功能？解决什么问题？

Example / 示例:
> As a user, I want to... so that I can... / 作为用户，我希望... 这样我就能...

## Proposed Solution / 建议方案

If you have an idea for how this could work, describe it here. / 如果你有实现思路，请在这里描述。

## Alternatives Considered / 考虑过的替代方案

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered. / 你考虑过的其他解决方案。

## Additional Context / 补充信息

Any other context, screenshots, or references. / 其他相关信息、截图或参考。
